visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with blonde hair and a white fluffy sweater stands in a bright indoor room, looking directly at the camera. She holds a rectangular instant noodle package with strawberry graphics, pointing her finger for emphasis. The background shows a modern kitchen-living area with warm lighting and wooden furniture. (2) Close-up on the woman's hands as she tears open the plastic lid of the noodle container. She pulls out three distinct seasoning packets: a green one, a red one with a strawberry icon, and a purple one. The white table surface and a stack of books are visible in the shallow background. (3) The woman is seen pouring hot water from a black kettle into the white plastic bowl containing the dried noodles. She then tears open the packets, squeezing a bright red liquid sauce and scattering dark red dried strawberry chunks onto the pale yellow noodles. (4) Holding the white bowl, the woman uses red chopsticks to vigorously mix the noodles, sauce, and dried fruit. She brings a large portion of the red-speckled noodles to her mouth and takes a big bite. Her eyes widen and her expression shifts to one of confusion and distaste as she continues to chew. (5) A man with dark hair in a grey shirt sits at a dining table. He holds the noodle bowl, leans in to smell it, and then uses chopsticks to take a bite. He immediately pulls back with a grimace, laughs awkwardly, and hands the bowl back out of the frame. (6) The woman and man are shown together, smiling and laughing at the camera. The woman covers her mouth with her hand while gesturing toward the noodles. The video ends with a shot of the empty, clean white plastic container held against a neutral greyish wall background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaks in Traditional Chinese with a bright, curious pitch. An upbeat J-pop background music track featuring female Japanese vocals and a fast electronic beat (approx. 130 BPM) begins immediately. The environment sounds like a quiet indoor room with minimal ambient noise. (2) A series of sharp, high-frequency plastic rustling sounds occur as the packaging is manipulated. The background music remains steady in volume and tempo. There is a faint metallic click as a lid or utensil is moved. No human speech is present in this short segment. (3) The female voice returns with a high pitch and excited prosody. A 'ding' sound effect with a clean, bell-like timbre punctuates the presentation of a sauce packet. The sound of liquid pouring into the container creates a mid-frequency splashing texture for a few seconds. (4) A loud, wet slurping sound is heard as noodles are consumed. This is followed by a sudden sharp gasp and a change in the speaker's vocal tone to a lower, more disappointed valence. The J-pop music continues to play underneath the high-density Chinese speech. (5) A male voice enters, speaking Japanese and then Chinese with a calm but skeptical tone. Another loud slurping sound occurs, followed by a comical 'drop' sound effect (like a cartoon slide). The man's voice exhibits a laughing quality as he rejects the food. (6) Both female and male voices overlap in a joyous, high-arousal chatter. They laugh frequently, their voices blending with the ongoing energetic music. The music swells slightly in volume before being cut off abruptly at the end of the recording.
